newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy diesel for January 1997.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy diesel for January 1997.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high speed diesel for January 1997 delivery, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks both 0.5 and 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for deliveries to Goa or Kandla on the West Coast and Madras or Haldia on the East Coast on cost-and-freight basis.
The tender closes on November 20 and offers will be valid until November 21.
In its last tender for December delivery, IOC bought 520,000 tonnes of diesel in 13 cargoes.
